pr_title: hostname: fix off-by-one issue in gethostname()
pr_body:
gethostname() returns null-terminated hostname.

Fixes #20309.
Fixes #20417.
pr_comments: I can confirm the patch works, thanks! I'll skip setting the green flag given the comments from others, though.
If gethostname() could possibly fail to null-terminate the string, maybe `buf` should actually be `HOST_NAME_MAX + 2` bytes long, and you should pass `HOST_NAME_MAX + 1` as the length parameter.

well uname() sizes the array as 65 (i.e. HOST_NAME_MAX+1) so we should be good on that front.

And in fact, maybe we should never use gethostname() and always use uname() (like we do elsewhere), since it avoids these pitfalls...
note that according to the gethostname() man page the glibc call will intrenally call uname() anyway. So we might just go for that right away and avoid the fuss
Thank you for comments. I will update soon.
Updated. Now, all `gethostname()` calls are replaced with `uname()`. PTAL.

issue_context.body:
**systemd version the issue has been seen with**
 > all

**Used distribution**
 > NA

**Linux kernel version used** (`uname -a`)
 > NA

**CPU architecture issue was seen on**
 > ALL

**Expected behaviour you didn't see**
 > I think there maybe a problem in commit https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/17859/commits/39ede7cc377dcb057411c80509e5fde8901f20fb.
As i tested the gethostname syscall with the test.c listed as below.
```
testtesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttest:~ # ./test
testtesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttest:~ # echo $?
220
testtesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttest:~ # cat test.c
#include <unistd.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>

int main()
{
        char buf[65] = {};
        if (gethostname(buf, sizeof(buf) -1) < 0)
                return -errno;
        printf("The hostname is %s,the len of buf is %d", buf, sizeof(buf));
}
```
When i set the hostname to a 64 7-bit ASCII lower-case alphanumeric characters like:
```
testtesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttesttest
```
The test.c couldn't get the hostname.
And when i used gethostname(buf, sizeof(buf)) instead of gethostname(buf, sizeof(buf) -1). I can get the hostname.
Maybe we should revert the commit https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/17859/commits/39ede7cc377dcb057411c80509e5fde8901f20fb?

 > The test.c couldn't get the hostname.
